biography.plain_text: Sheikh Hamdan bin Zayed Al Nahyan is an Emirati royal and the Ruler's Representative in Abu Dhabi's Al Dhafra Region. A son of UAE founder Sheikh Zayed, he studied political science and business administration before holding senior foreign-affairs and federal-government posts. His present office centres on regional administration, services and community engagement.

A son of UAE founder Sheikh Zayed, he studied political science and business administration before holding senior foreign-affairs and federal-government posts. His present office centres on regional administration, services and community engagement.

confidence.reason: Established UAE reporting supports Hamdan's lineage, education and federal-service background, while current official sources confirm his Al Dhafra office, regional administration and community engagement.

long_biography.plain_text:
Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi gives Sheikh Hamdan bin Zayed Al Nahyan a central role in environmental regulation, biodiversity protection and water security. As chairman, he launched a coral-rehabilitation programme using nurseries, replanting, artificial reefs and scientific monitoring to restore damaged marine habitats.

His chairmanship of Emirates Red Crescent provides a separate humanitarian responsibility. The organisation directs relief and community support, including sustained provision for orphan care. Under Hamdan's directives, it contributed to the Mother of the Nation Endowment, a programme created to fund long-term care and community support for orphans.
